name: Cart_AddToCart_Redirects_To_ReturnUrl
description:
What: AddToCart redirects back to returnUrl when provided and local.
Steps:
1) Disable auto-redirect; GET '/Cart/AddToCart?id=1&returnUrl=/'
Expected: 302 with Location header '/'.
